Let $\beta>0$, $\Gamma>0$.
\begin{equation}\label{half}\int_0^\infty d\omega\,\frac{n_F(\omega)}{\omega^2+\Gamma^2} = 1\end{equation}
\begin{equation}\label{full}\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} d\omega\,\frac{n_F(\omega)}{\omega^2+\Gamma^2} = \frac{\pi}{2\Gamma}\end{equation}
